findings.claim: The plan gives the workflow per-audit artifacts (agent-report-NAME) but gives action.yml only an `audit` input. action.yml uploads and downloads a fixed artifact named `agent-report`, so a workflow that uses the action (the one section 5 of the how-to shows) cannot run the three audits as a matrix: upload-artifact@v4 refuses a second artifact with the same name in one run, and each publish leg would download the same one. The how-to would then name three audits that a `uses:` user can only run one per workflow. The plan must say how the action names its artifact per audit (for example agent-report-AUDIT, or an artifact input) and that publish mode downloads the matching one, or say that the action runs one audit per workflow and the docs show that.
